name: linear_get_issue
description: Fetch one Linear issue by its `id` (the UUID, or the human identifier like 'ENG-123' also resolves). Returns { id, identifier, title, description, priority, state{name}, assignee{name}, team{id name}, url }.

body_defaults.query: query GetIssue($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { id identifier title description priority state { name } assignee { name } team { id name } url } }
